questions.explanation: For any two numbers, product = HCF × LCM, so LCM = 84 ÷ 2 = 42.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Find the smallest number that must be added to 245 to make it exactly divisible by 9.
questions.explanation: 245 leaves remainder 2 when divided by 9, so 9 − 2 = 7 must be added.

questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.explanation: The third decimal digit is 1, so nothing is added: 3.14.

questions.explanation: The first two significant figures are 6 and 7; the next digit 8 rounds up: 0.0068.

questions.explanation: Keep 4, 9, 5 and round the ten-thousands place down: 4,950,000.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: A bag costs ₦4,999.95. Express this to the nearest naira.
questions.explanation: The 95 kobo is more than half a naira, so it rounds up to ₦5,000.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: A road is measured as 4.62 km, correct to 2 decimal places. What is the smallest possible length of the road?
questions.explanation: A measurement to 2 d.p. could be half a hundredth below, so the lower bound is 4.615 km.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Express 6.3748 correct to 3 decimal places.

questions.subject: Mathematics
